environment: Chromium embedded portable HTML; simulated storage; captured download blobs.

results.name: Fresh startup has no slogans, welcome overlay or idle instructions
Search and six compact catalog controls expose the parts grid above the fold
Category selection and named-part search retain module/controller discovery
Every compact library button opens its complete existing workflow
Library tools is keyboard-operable and keeps its state through inspector refresh
Active trace guidance is concise; tool help does not change the board or tool
Via tool retains net/placement cautions and its complete on-demand instructions
Part placement uses one context hint rather than a second instructional toast
Keyboard and touch-accessible help retains displaced instructions and limitations
Legacy welcome preferences do not restore clutter or discard saved UI settings
Live error/warning counts and the fabrication export gate remain visible
Autosave failures still display an explicit warning and JSON backup remains available
Plain panel headings retain board fabrication limits and the active silkscreen face
Fabrication retains exported-layer selection, CAM caution and identical file bytes
Compact and active-tool layouts remain usable from 360 to 900 pixels wide
Dark and high-contrast themes retain readable controls and status indicators
The 193-part library and schema-5 native round trip remain unchanged
Quiet-workbench interactions need no external requests and raise no uncaught errors
